steps.description: [Target Component: React State Context] Interactivity: Select a 366 Days Date Range (e.g. 2024-01-01 to 2025-01-01).

expectedResults.description: Date state updates, BUT Export Button explicitly switches state to `disabled=true` protecting the backend limit.

steps.description: [Target Component: POST /api/v1/dashboard/export/pdf Endpoint] Using Postman or API injector, forge a POST request bypassing the UI explicitly using the 366-day JSON payload.

expectedResults.description: Backend validator immediately catches the violation and terminates the request returning exact HTTP 400 Bad Request.
